name: Fresh Blueberries (Tough Outer Skin Warning)
whyItWorks: Blueberries lack the hard woody seeds of raspberries, but possess a tough outer taut skin made of insoluble cellulose. In sensitive GI tracts or during flare-ups, these skins frequently pass through whole and undigested.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy in remission in small handfuls. During flare-ups, stew blueberries in a saucepan until skins burst and soften, or blend thoroughly into a pureed smoothie.
watchOuts: Tough exterior skins can cause abdominal cramping and appear intact in stool.
